(So that we don't have to worry about EIP-161 removal of empty accounts kicking in or not.) cc <@539495253418180618> <@291925846556540928> there will be no 0 value withdrawals In an unlikely case like a mass leak, it's possible that you may get an empty list of withdrawals, but you'll not get any individual withdrawal with amount == 0, hopefully that answers as completely as possible for you <@583892532644151312> CL literally skips past any that don't have a balance to transfer, so that we can be more efficient in filling the space. correct there will be no zero value withdrawals. I have nothing against enshrining that in 4895 if it reduces complexity <@539495253418180618> I made a PR to fix the nullable fields in the engine API https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/332 I originally thought we needed an additional note in `engine_getPayloadV2` similar to the ones in `engine_forkchoiceUpdatedV2` and `engine_newPayloadV2` but I realized that point 1 in the [`Payload Building`](https://github.com/ethDreamer/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/specification.md#payload-building) section should already cover it <@583892532644151312> want me to update the EIP to explicitly say the amount will always be greater than 0? happy to do so

excerpts.author: yperbasis
excerpts.content: There'll be no 0-value withdrawals, will there? Can we enshrine that in EIP-4895? (So that we don't have to worry about EIP-161 removal of empty accounts kicking in or not.)

excerpts.author: .paulharris
excerpts.content: there will be no 0 value withdrawals

excerpts.author: .paulharris
excerpts.content:
In an unlikely case like a mass leak, it's possible that you may get an empty list of withdrawals, but you'll not get any individual withdrawal with amount == 0, hopefully that answers as completely as possible for you <@583892532644151312> 
CL literally skips past any that don't have a balance to transfer, so that we can be more efficient in filling the space.

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
correct there will be no zero value withdrawals.

I have nothing against enshrining that in 4895 if it reduces complexity

excerpts.author: ethdreamer
excerpts.content:

excerpts.author: ethdreamer
excerpts.content: I originally thought we needed an additional note in `engine_getPayloadV2` similar to the ones in `engine_forkchoiceUpdatedV2` and `engine_newPayloadV2` but I realized that point 1 in the [`Payload Building`](https://github.com/ethDreamer/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/specification.md#payload-building) section should already cover it

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: <@583892532644151312> want me to update the EIP to explicitly say the amount will always be greater than 0? happy to do so
